examples.ar: هَذَا بَيْتٌ قَدِيمٌ مَبْنِيٌّ مِنَ الحَجَرِ الأَبْيَضِ.
examples.en: This is an old house built of white stone.

examples.ar: حَفِظْتُ بَيْتًا مِنَ الشِّعْرِ الجَاهِلِيِّ العَرِيقِ.
examples.en: I memorized a verse from the ancient pre-Islamic poetry.

examples.ar: البَحْرُ وَاسِعٌ وَعَمِيقٌ وَمَلِيءٌ بِالكِائِنَاتِ المَائِيَّةِ.
examples.en: The sea is vast, deep, and full of marine creatures.

examples.ar: رَكِبَ التَّاجِرُ البَحْرَ فِي طَرِيقِهِ إِلَى السِّنْدِ.
examples.en: The merchant traveled by sea on his way to Sindh.
The guard opened the school gate for the visitors.

examples.ar: هَذَا البَابُ مِنَ الكِتَابِ يَتَحَدَّثُ عَنِ النَّحْوِ.
examples.en: This chapter of the book speaks about grammar.

examples.ar: القَنَاعَةُ كَنْزٌ يَجْلِبُ البَرَكَةَ فِي الرِّزْقِ.
examples.en: Contentment is a treasure that brings blessing in livelihood.

examples.ar: حَلَّتِ البَرَكَةُ فِي المَنْزِلِ بِحُضُورِ الجَدِّ.
examples.en: Blessing descended upon the house with the grandfather's presence.

examples.ar: سَافَرْتُ إِلَى بَلَدٍ جَدِيدٍ لِأَوَّلِ مَرَّةٍ فِي حَيَاتِي.
examples.en: I traveled to a new country for the first time in my life.

examples.ar: فِي البُسْتَانِ زُهُورٌ مُلَوَّنَةٌ وَأَشْجَارُ تُفَّاحٍ.
examples.en: In the garden are colorful flowers and apple trees.

examples.ar: تَتَجَلَّى البَرَاءَةُ فِي عُيُونِ الأَطْفَالِ الصِّغَارِ.
examples.en: Innocence is manifested in the eyes of young children.
And We made him hearing and seeing.

examples.ar: فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ.
examples.en: And We have removed from you your cover, so your sight today is sharp.

examples.ar: يَتَطَلَّبُ بِنَاءُ الأُمَمِ تَعْلِيمًا قَوِيًّا وَأَخْلَاقًا عَالِيَةً.
examples.en: Building nations requires strong education and high morals.
